scheme_name: Indira Gandhi Shehri Credit Card Yojana
other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Rajasthan
Monthly income of the applicant must not exceed Rs 15,000
Family monthly income must not exceed Rs 50,000
Must possess a certificate or identity card issued by the urban body
Alternatively, a recommendation letter from the Town Vending Committee is acceptable
Selection during the survey makes the applicant eligible
benefits_summary: Interest‑free loan up to Rs 50,000 to support informal sector businesses and promote self‑employment.
documents_required: Certificate or identity card issued by the urban body
Recommendation letter from Town Vending Committee
